_comment: Game UI points for a 2880x1800 CLIENT area - the owner's test device (created 2026-09-24 by the twin test session, docs/briefs/2026-09-24-minimap-twin-test-assignment.md). The game runs full screen on the only monitor at (0,0): client pixels = screen pixels. The game scales its UI by the height (1800 / 1200 = 1.5x of the 1200-high reference), so nothing here is the 2560x1080 sheet scaled: every point was measured on a full-resolution capture of THIS screen. Provenance format as in 2560x1080.json.

_layout.provenance: measured 2026-09-24 live/00_window.png (PrintWindow capture of the home menu at 2880x1800, game v100.19.18309.0, 15:30; its column and probe pixels as numbers in scripts/gameio/tests/fixtures/menu_2880_20260924.json): the button frame (253,228,163) peaks in brightness at column x = 186 (a horizontal gradient: 174,144,67 at x 40, 170,140,63 at x 340), so the column is 186. Frame rows at x = 186: 377-378/431-432, 460/514, 542-543/596-597, 625/679, 707-708/761-762, 790/844, 872-873/926-927, 955/1009, 1037-1038/1091-1092 - nine buttons at an 82.5 px pitch, every second one with 1-row lines (a 2-px line at 1.5x scale); the black outline (max channel <= 11) sits 2 rows outside each line (e.g. 375 above 377, 434 below 432), hence line_rows_min 1 and dark_gap 2; the outline's darkest pixel is max channel 7-11 between buttons and (15,11,7) under Tools (row 1094), hence dark_max 16 (the 2560 rule's 12 misses the last line). 'buttons' = each button's frame rows; frame_lines = each line's first row.

_not_entered.lobby (no namespace in the contract): measured and clicked live 2026-09-24 on the Single Player Skirmish lobby: map button (2455,642) = aitest lobby_mapbutton; in the picker the Select Type dropdown (666,306), its 'Custom Maps' row (388,400) - the MOD maps are only under Custom Maps, All Maps finds no London by any name -, search box (1843,307), first tile (307,590), OK (2294,1604); Play (2471,1708) = aitest lobby_play. The picker applies its search text only when it opens (type, Esc, reopen) and reopening resets Select Type to All Maps: choose Custom Maps AFTER the reopen. London's tile is 'Restoration of the Monarchy'.
